Sezzle’s pay‑in‑4 plan splits a purchase into four equal payments over six weeks. The first 25% is charged at checkout. The next three 25% payments are auto‑charged every two weeks on the due dates shown in the app. You can pay any installment early at no cost, but early payment does not change future due dates.
